articles.title: A LatAm telecom operator is putting part of its finances on Avalanche
articles.snippet: Led by former IBM Blockchain partner Jules Miller, Iris is helping Bolivia's VIVA use stablecoins for settlement, dollar reserves and new financial services without replacing its existing telecom systems.

articles.title: Circle debuts Arc blockchain which Jeremy Allaire calls ‘more consequential’ than USDC
articles.snippet: The USDC issuer's chain is built for payments, tokenized assets and institutional finance as banks and payment giants pile into the stablecoin market.

articles.title: Fed meeting is shaping up to be a nightmare for Warsh. Bitcoin might still shine
articles.snippet: An aggressive market expectations trap and a strict aversion to forward guidance have backed the Fed chair into a corner, where failing to deliver a hawkish message risks destroying the central bank’s inflation-fighting credibility.

articles.title: Zcash holders back 25-second blocks, vote to keep ZEC halving schedule
articles.snippet: Nearly 99% of ZEC holders voted to reduce block times to 25 seconds, while keeping ZEC issuance and halving schedules unchanged.

articles.title: Ethiopia cuts Bitcoin miners’ power by 77% amid hydropower shortage: Report
articles.snippet: Bitcoin miners generated 35% of the state-owned power producer’s revenue last year, but declining reservoir inflows led the utility to prioritize households and manufacturers.
